summary: Iter 72 refactor + lock verified. VoiceStatusRow shared component is in place; all 3 chat surfaces (ClarityRelease, BodyRoomChat, ParentsRoomChat) import and use it. All 11 pytest assertions pass (3 phase1_voice_status_lock + 8 phase0_numbered_list_strip). /clarity-release loads cleanly with 0 console errors, 0 banned label leaks in DOM. guide-face JPEG endpoints return 200 with the exact contract-spec byte sizes.
critical_code_review_comments: VoiceStatusRow.jsx is clean (~127 lines), well-documented, single-responsibility, and properly typed via JSDoc props. The component contract (props, banned-label guard, allowed-label whitelist) is well-pinned by the 3 source-level regression tests.

BodyRoomChat.jsx and ParentsRoomChat.jsx still keep their OWN inline mute toggle button next to the textarea (data-testid 'body-room-chat-mute' / 'parents-room-chat-mute'). This is intentional per the iter 72 design (VoiceStatusRow only carries showMuteToggle on the clarity variant) but means there are still two parallel mute affordances per chat surface — flag for founder review if any future iter wants the mute UX truly unified.

BodyRoomChat.jsx is 579 lines (still under the 700-line threshold but trending up — the SomaticTtsButton sub-component could be extracted to its own file in a future cleanup, mirroring how VoiceStatusRow was extracted).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (page load + 0 console errors + 0 banned-label DOM leaks)

test_credentials: Not exercised — /clarity-release unauthenticated landed on the consent-threshold gate as expected by route guards. Live beta test of authed flow is founder-owned per the request.
